values.binNote: Wiki states the reduction as a positive magnitude (20 to 80); the bin stores it as a negative modifier ([-20/-35/-50/-65/-80]) since it's subtracted from AD. Same magnitude, opposite sign convention.
Wiki states the slow as a positive percentage (30 to 50); the bin stores it as a negative modifier ([-0.3/-0.35/-0.4/-0.45/-0.5]) applied to move speed. Same magnitude, opposite sign convention.

mechanics.claim: The attack damage reduction applies only to bonus attack damage, not base AD.
mechanics.quote: reduces the {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}} of nearby enemy champions for 4 seconds

mechanics.claim: If reduction would push bonus AD below 0, base AD is unaffected but total AD is still reduced, and effects that scale off total AD reflect the reduction while those scaling off base/bonus AD do not.
mechanics.quote: If the attack damage reduction would reduce the target's {{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}} below {{as|0|ad}}, the target's {{as|'''base''' attack damage}} value is unaffected, but their {{as|'''total''' attack damage}} will still be reduced.

mechanics.claim: Mocking Shout prevents Tryndamere from using Undying Rage during its cast time.
mechanics.quote: ''Mocking Shout'' prevents '''Tryndamere''' from using ''Undying Rage'' during its cast time.
